summary: Terra Mystica is a no-luck strategy game where each player's asymmetric faction terraforms hex terrain to expand a network of buildings, upgrade structures, and climb four cult tracks. Games are quiet and cerebral, with success coming from efficient long-term resource planning rather than direct confrontation.
praised: deep, satisfying economic engine with zero luck
highly asymmetric factions that each play differently
rewarding for players who like optimization puzzles
criticised: steep learning curve and a slow, unrewarding first play
can feel dry and math-heavy rather than thematic
needs a full table and careful faction balance to sing

interaction.detail: Players build on a single shared hex board where adjacency to other players' structures grants bonuses, so land grabs and blocking opponents' expansion routes are central; cult tracks are also a shared, contested resource.

scoring.why: Points trickle in throughout the game from building, network size, cult track position, favor tiles, and town founding, plus a final area-scoring round.
scoring.how_you_win: You win by out-expanding and out-upgrading opponents on the shared board while squeezing extra points from cult tracks and favors along the way.
